findings.title: Upload size limit bypassable; full body read into memory
findings.evidence: routes.py:117-127 trusts content-length header; routes.py:156 await file.read() unbounded before any cap
findings.recommendation: Stream the upload in chunks and abort once cumulative bytes exceed settings.max_file_size_bytes.

findings.title: README install uses invalid uv extras syntax
findings.evidence: README.md:87-88 `uv sync --all-extras,ml` is not valid uv syntax
findings.recommendation: Remove line 88 (--all-extras already covers ml) or use `uv sync --extra ml`.

findings.title: ffmpeg-python abandoned (last release 2019-07-06)
findings.evidence: pyproject.toml:161 ffmpeg-python>=0.2.0; PyPI last release 0.2.0 on 2019-07-06 (~6y10m)
findings.recommendation: Migrate to a maintained wrapper or call ffmpeg via subprocess with validated args; treat current pin as frozen.

findings.title: preprocessing/ is a parallel orphaned reimplementation of services/
findings.evidence: preprocessing/vad.py:58 vs services/vad_processor.py:81; no production importer of preprocessing.*; tech-spec.md:110-111 names services classes as canonical
findings.recommendation: Pick one home: delete preprocessing/ and its tests, or demote it to a helper layer that services/ actually calls.

findings.title: Spec-mandated VAD/conditioning not wired into the pipeline
findings.evidence: audio_tasks.py:99-136 uses only converter+assessor; ADR-002 mandates VAD+RMS; AudioConditioner/VADProcessor/DOMBuilder/TranscriptFormatter have zero production callers
findings.recommendation: Integrate AudioConditioner/VADProcessor per ADR-002, or amend the ADR to record the features as deferred.

findings.title: Audio API has no authentication or authorization
findings.evidence: routes.py defines process/status/results/artifacts with zero auth dependencies; grep Depends|Security|Bearer returns 0
findings.recommendation: Add a router-level auth dependency (API key or OAuth2/JWT) and authorize result/artifact reads per caller identity.

findings.title: README describes nonexistent API and CLI commands
findings.evidence: README.md:96-104 imports nonexistent YourModule; :110-116 shows nonexistent `process` CLI (only hello/config exist); :478-483 lists nonexistent core.py
findings.recommendation: Rewrite Overview/Usage/Structure from the real modules; port accurate content up from docs/guides/.

findings.title: Base image digest pin goes stale, no auto security refresh
findings.evidence: Dockerfile:7,42 digest-pin python:3.12-slim; .trivyignore enumerates ~30 base-image CVEs that accrue until the digest is manually bumped
findings.recommendation: Add a scheduled job (or Renovate Docker) to bump the base-image digest on a cadence and re-run Trivy.

findings.title: Cookiecutter demo tasks (incl. fake send_email_task) live in worker
findings.evidence: worker.py:71 example_background_task, :102 send_email_task stub returns sent without sending, :138 process_file_upload; all registered :246-248
findings.recommendation: Delete the three demo tasks and their registrations; a stub email reporting success is a correctness hazard.

findings.title: Duplicated audio-load helper across 3 services and loader
findings.evidence: Token-identical sf.read/librosa.load fallback at quality_assessor.py:166, audio_conditioner.py:233, vad_processor.py:177/288, loader.py:92
findings.recommendation: Extract one load_audio(path, dtype) helper (reuse loader.py) and call it from the three services.

findings.title: Tests un-collectable and coverage unmeasurable without extras
findings.evidence: pytest --collect-only -> 80 of 458 collected, 14 modules ERROR on import of missing extras; pytest-cov absent in partial env
findings.recommendation: Run the gate in CI with uv sync --all-extras and guard heavy-dep test modules with pytest.importorskip; record the real coverage figure.

findings.title: Two exception modules; orphaned one used only by preprocessing/
findings.evidence: exceptions.py (36 lines) imported only by preprocessing/ffmpeg.py:21 and loader.py:16; all live code uses core/exceptions.py
findings.recommendation: Fold AudioLoadError/FfmpegConversionError into core/exceptions.py and delete the top-level module.

findings.title: Duplicated config values; preprocessing hardcodes config-owned tuning
findings.evidence: config.py:103-163 owns the tuning values; preprocessing/loader.py:21 hardcodes TARGET_SAMPLE_RATE=16000 and quality.py:62 hardcodes 0.99
findings.recommendation: Route preprocessing constants through core.config.settings, or remove them with ARCH-01.

findings.title: torch 2.9.1 unpatched local-CE CVE present in optional extras
findings.evidence: uv.lock pins torch 2.9.1, no upstream fix; suppressed pyproject.toml:648-653; absent from prod image (uv sync --no-dev, no --extra)
findings.recommendation: Keep the suppression; bump torch>= once a fixed release lands (reassess 2026-07-26). No action for the production image.

findings.title: Sentry before_send scrubbing shallow and key-list-limited
findings.evidence: sentry.py:198-208 redacts only top-level keys in request data for a fixed 4-key set; headers, query string, and nested dicts not scrubbed
findings.recommendation: Recurse into nested structures, scrub request headers and the URL query string, match key names case-insensitively by substring.

findings.title: Test + coverage suite runs twice on every PR
findings.evidence: ci.yml:33 and pr-validation.yml:36 both call python-ci.yml@799ebd6 on identical PR triggers
findings.recommendation: Chain pr-validation off ci (workflow_run) or move its extra jobs into ci.yml and delete the duplicate caller.

findings.title: Reusable-workflow SHA skew across callers
findings.evidence: 12 callers pin @799ebd6 but container-security.yml:43 and mutation-testing.yml:36 pin @a81c5c7
findings.recommendation: Pin all org reusable-workflow callers to a single reviewed SHA and update them together.

findings.title: basedpyright declared twice with conflicting floors
findings.evidence: pyproject.toml:92 basedpyright>=1.18.0 vs pyproject.toml:835 basedpyright>=1.35.0
findings.recommendation: Keep a single basedpyright>=1.35.0 declaration and remove the stale >=1.18.0 line.

findings.title: Coverage gate authority split and partly soft
findings.evidence: Hard gate --cov-fail-under=80 (pyproject.toml:548) vs Codecov patch threshold 5% (.codecov.yml:28) and per-flag targets 70%
findings.recommendation: Treat --cov-fail-under=80 as source of truth, tighten Codecov patch threshold, verify the reusable workflow is not continue-on-error.

findings.title: draft_*.md files duplicate and contradict finalized planning docs
findings.evidence: Four draft files (3142 lines, titled Project E) duplicate planning/; index.md:39 and PROJECT-PLAN.md:361 still link to them
findings.recommendation: Delete the four drafts and repoint the two references at docs/planning/adr/adr-001 and adr-002.

findings.title: planning/README shows Awaiting Generation for docs that exist
findings.evidence: planning/README.md:37-40 marks project-vision/tech-spec/roadmap/adr as Awaiting Generation though all are populated
findings.recommendation: Update the four status cells to Generated/Accepted; feed the placeholder pattern back to the template.

findings.title: pydub unmaintained; audioop removed in Python 3.13
findings.evidence: pyproject.toml:160 pydub>=0.25.1; PyPI last release 2021-03-10; imports audioop removed by PEP 594, and requires-python:12 admits 3.13
findings.recommendation: Drop pydub for librosa/soundfile, or add audioop-lts; python_version>='3.13' and test on 3.13. Verify it is actually imported first.

findings.title: 109 inline ignores on 2 untyped lib boundaries, no prose reason
findings.evidence: git grep -> 109 rule-coded ignores; 36 in cache.py (redis+structlog), 24 in sentry.py (sentry_sdk dict access); none carry the inline reason CLAUDE.md requires
findings.recommendation: Type the structlog logger once, wrap redis (or add stubs), add a one-line reason per remaining block to shrink toward ~20 irreducible cases.

findings.title: Heavy libs imported at module top; services unimportable without extras
findings.evidence: numpy/torch/librosa/scipy/soundfile are top-level runtime imports (services/vad_processor.py:15-18 et al) but live behind extras (pyproject.toml:127-163), so import audio_processor.services hard-fails without extras
findings.recommendation: Defer heavy imports into method bodies or TYPE_CHECKING (mirror the deepgram lazy-import at audio_tasks.py:159) so the extras boundary is real.

findings.title: Tool versions float in pyproject but SHA-pinned in pre-commit
findings.evidence: ruff pre-commit v0.15.13 vs pyproject ruff>=0.9.0; bandit pre-commit 1.7.10 vs pyproject >=1.7.0; uv run and the hook can disagree
findings.recommendation: Pin pyproject floors to match the pre-commit revs so CI, local uv run, and pre-commit run identical linter versions.

findings.title: api-reference omits all audio modules
findings.evidence: api-reference.md renders only core.config, utils.logging, cli; services/preprocessing/jobs/api/core.models (the bulk of the library) are undocumented
findings.recommendation: Add mkdocstrings blocks for services, preprocessing, jobs, api, and core.models so the API site matches the shipped code.

findings.title: basedpyright 626 warnings contradict the strict-clean claim
findings.evidence: basedpyright src/ -> 59 errors (42 env import artifacts) and 626 warnings, 521 reportUnknown* from untyped redis/librosa/numpy/sentry; CLAUDE.md claims strict-mode clean
findings.recommendation: Re-run against a synced env, then set reportUnknown* severities with rationale or add typed adapters; reconcile the CLAUDE.md claim. Do not add more inline ignores.

findings.title: py 1.11.0 deprecated dev-only transitive (suppressed ReDoS)
findings.evidence: uv.lock py 1.11.0 via interrogate; PyPI 2021-11-04 maintenance-mode; suppression accurate (dev-only, svnwc unreachable, excluded from wheels) pyproject.toml:647
findings.recommendation: Keep the documented suppression; at the 2026-07-16 reassess, replace interrogate to drop py entirely.

findings.title: ClusterFuzzLite base tag unpinned, unpinned pip installs
findings.evidence: .clusterfuzzlite/Dockerfile:6 FROM base-builder-python:v1 (mutable tag); pip3 install atheris with no version constraint
findings.recommendation: Pin the base image by digest and constrain atheris to a known version for reproducible fuzz runs.

findings.title: Minor direct-dependency version lag
findings.evidence: arq lock 0.25.0 vs latest 0.28.0 (2026-04-16); silero-vad 6.2.0 vs 6.2.1; none crosses the 18-month line
findings.recommendation: Run a routine uv sync --upgrade to close the gap.

findings.title: Dead function parameter include_correlation in setup_logging
findings.evidence: logging.py:42 declares include_correlation; referenced only in docstring :56/:64, never in the body; vulture 100% confidence
findings.recommendation: Wire the flag into the structlog processor chain or remove the parameter; as written it is a false promise to callers.

findings.title: Commented-out SendGrid integration block
findings.evidence: worker.py:124-127 four commented import/usage lines tagged # noqa: ERA001; the only commented-out code in src
findings.recommendation: Delete the block with the demo task (LEG-02); track email as an issue if it is a real roadmap item.

findings.title: vulture missing from the dev toolchain
findings.evidence: uv run vulture fails (not installed); pyproject lists ruff/basedpyright/bandit/pip-audit but not vulture; had to run via uvx
findings.recommendation: Add vulture as a dev dependency with a committed whitelist or --min-confidence 80 plus per-decorator ignores.

findings.title: from __future__ import annotations missing in 7 of 31 files
findings.evidence: 24/31 src files carry it; missing in cli.py, utils/logging.py, and 5 __init__/stub files; CLAUDE.md lists it as required
findings.recommendation: Add the future import to cli.py and utils/logging.py at minimum for consistency with the stated standard.

findings.title: Six tests assert nothing meaningful
findings.evidence: assert True at test_example.py:388 and test_correlation.py:16; no-assert tests at test_cache.py:121, test_sentry.py:394 and :430
findings.recommendation: Assert real post-conditions for the should-not-raise tests; delete the assert True placeholders.

findings.title: Dated CI hardening TODOs near 2026-06-30
findings.evidence: 5 tighten-egress-after-2026-06-30 TODOs (oldest blame 2026-05-18); zero TODO/FIXME in src and tests
findings.recommendation: Track the 2026-06-30 step-security egress hardening as a dated task and flip the audit-mode workflows to block on schedule.

findings.title: Env reads outside core/config.py
findings.evidence: cache.py:81 reads REDIS_URL; sentry.py:87,94-97 read SENTRY_DSN/ENVIRONMENT/RELEASE via os.getenv outside the Settings class
findings.recommendation: Promote REDIS_URL and the Sentry vars to Settings fields and read them through settings.

findings.title: Template residue: financial util, empty middleware, payment docs
findings.evidence: utils/financial.py is an unused 1-line stub; middleware/__init__.py is empty with no importers; real cost logic lives in deepgram_client.py:48-50
findings.recommendation: Remove the unused util and empty package; trim payment-specific boilerplate from project docs.

findings.title: PYSEC-2026-161 suppression note stale (already patched)
findings.evidence: pyproject.toml:152-154 comment cites the issue; lock has fastapi 0.136.3 / starlette 1.1.0 (fix landed 1.0.1); no live ignore-vuln entry
findings.recommendation: Clarify or remove the comment to note the issue is fixed by the pinned versions. No security risk.

findings.title: README example uses moving @main reusable-workflow ref
findings.evidence: README.md:162 shows uses: ...python-ci.yml@main (doc example); all 16 active reusable refs and every third-party action are SHA-pinned
findings.recommendation: Pin the README example to a SHA to model the correct pattern. No runtime exposure.

findings.title: Coverage uploaded to Qlty twice (coverage.yml and qlty.yml)
findings.evidence: coverage.yml:26 and qlty.yml:18 both call python-qlty-coverage.yml@799ebd6 on CI workflow_run with the same coverage.xml artifact
findings.recommendation: Delete one; keep the variant with the workflow_dispatch manual re-run input (coverage.yml).

findings.title: Orphaned .semgrep.yml not run anywhere
findings.evidence: .semgrep.yml present (740 bytes); grep across workflows, pre-commit, and noxfile finds zero references
findings.recommendation: Wire a Semgrep CI job or pre-commit hook that consumes the config, or remove the dead file.

findings.title: Qlty complexity threshold looser than house standard
findings.evidence: qlty.toml:86 global function_complexity threshold 10, raised to 12 for Python at :96; CLAUDE.md mandates the stricter gate
findings.recommendation: Drop the Python function_complexity override back to 10 or document why audio code needs 12.

findings.title: Core CI only exercises Python 3.12
findings.evidence: requires-python 3.11-3.13 (pyproject.toml:12) but ci.yml:35, codeql, sonar, slsa hard-code 3.12; only the paths-filtered weekly matrix tests 3.11/3.13
findings.recommendation: Run core CI lint/type/test across the full supported range, or narrow requires-python to >=3.12.

findings.title: No ADR for the ARQ background-job decision
findings.evidence: jobs use ARQ (worker.py, audio_tasks.py) but grep arq over adr dirs returns nothing; adr-001:30 says Redis Queue generically; preprocessing/services split also undocumented
findings.recommendation: Add ADR-003 recording ARQ selection (vs RQ/Celery) and the module boundary, or append a Job framework subsection to ADR-001.

findings.title: CHANGELOG references Poetry; duplicate Fixed header
findings.evidence: [0.1.0] cites Poetry package management though the project uses UV; the [Unreleased] block has two back-to-back ### Fixed headers
findings.recommendation: Replace Poetry with UV in the [0.1.0] lines and merge the two Fixed subsections.

findings.title: Conflicting Python version statements across docs
findings.evidence: pyproject.toml:12 is >=3.11,<3.14 but README.md:60 says 3.10+, PYTHON_COMPATIBILITY.md:13 says 3.10-3.14, CONTRIBUTING.md:27 says 3.12+
findings.recommendation: Standardize on Python 3.11-3.13, primary 3.12 across README, PYTHON_COMPATIBILITY, CONTRIBUTING, and the docs tree.

findings.title: Generic Payment/Financial guidance retained in audio project
findings.evidence: CLAUDE.md:79,97 carry payment-processing RAD examples and :445 documents utils/financial.py; inherited from .standards/CLAUDE.baseline.md
findings.recommendation: Replace the payment/financial RAD category with an audio-relevant one (ASR API calls, FFmpeg subprocess, large-file streaming).

findings.title: Model Selection table duplicated across agent docs
findings.evidence: CLAUDE.md Model Selection section and AGENTS.md:11-23 both restate the Opus/Sonnet/Haiku tiers; the rest of the agent-doc set is well factored
findings.recommendation: Optional: single-source the Model Selection table and link to it from the other file.

findings.title: Six overlapping SAST/quality tools; CodeQL runs twice
findings.evidence: CodeQL runs in codeql.yml:60 and security-analysis.yml:42 (double SARIF risk); Bandit findings also surface in Sonar and Qlty
findings.recommendation: Pick one owner per finding class (CodeQL for SAST, Bandit for Python security, Sonar for maintainability) and disable the duplicate CodeQL run.

findings.title: pre-commit hooks not mirrored in CI (local-only gates)
findings.evidence: darglint, interrogate, no-em-dash, validate-front-matter run only in pre-commit; only vulture appears as a CI job (pr-validation.yml:78), so the rest can be bypassed
findings.recommendation: Add a CI job running pre-commit run --all-files, or confirm the org python-ci.yml already does.
